prompt:

and what was measured.

- round 3: Clear path option copy revision [choose_path, copy]: predicted -1.0%, measured -6.4% ± 1.7%, after noise correction -5.2%, stopped early: choose_path worse
- round 3: Pet interaction visual tips screen [finish, new_screen]: predicted +2.0%, measured -5.2% ± 3.2%, after noise correction -2.9%, lost: no clear effect
- round 3: Checklist layout for photo upload screen [adoption, layout]: predicted +4.5%, measured -1.2% ± 2.2%, after noise correction -0.9%, lost: no clear effect
- round 3: Desktop launch info on waiting screen [home, wait_info]: predicted +1.5%, measured -0.4% ± 1.9%, after noise correction -0.3%, lost: no clear effect
- round 4: Split layout sign-in screen redesign [sign_in, redesign]: predicted +3.0%, measured -15.1% ± 3.9%, after noise correction -7.0%, stopped early: sign_in worse
- round 4: Desktop companion placement guide screen [finish, new_screen]: predicted -1.0%, measured -13.6% ± 4.0%, after noise correction -6.2%, stopped early: finish worse
- round 4: Split layout redesign for adoption certificate [adoption, redesign]: predicted +5.0%, measured +5.8% ± 2.2%, after noise correction +4.3%, won
- round 4: Story scroll layout for story screen [choose_path, redesign]: predicted +1.0%, measured +1.6% ± 1.4%, after noise correction +1.4%, lost: no clear effect

By kind of change, after noise correction:
- adoption, layout: -0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +5.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -4.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -4.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, notification: +1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -7.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

One test is weak evidence. State a rule only when at least 2 tests of that kind agree after noise correction; otherwise say the evidence is still thin.

Previous lessons:
Evidence is still thin for most specific change types because only choose_path copy and home wait_info have at least two tests.
Copy changes in choose_path (choose_path, copy) consistently made performance worse across multiple tests.
Waiting step info (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Redesigning friend selection (adoption, redesign) and reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) were helpful, winning their tests.
Layout changes, notification toggles, and new visual tip screens had no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured outcomes.

Rewrite the lessons: at most 6 short rules about which kinds of change worked, which did not, and
where your predictions were too high or too low. Call a kind of change helpful only if a test of that
kind won (was significant); for tests with no clear effect, say no effect was seen, even if the numbers
lean one way. Keep rules that still hold, drop ones the data contradicts. Return JSON {"lessons": ["..."]}

lessons: Evidence is still thin for single-test kinds of changes (adoption layout, choose_path redesign, finish layout, sign_in redesign, sign_in reorder).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) consistently worked well and proved helpful.
Copy changes in choose_path (choose_path, copy) consistently made performance worse.
Notification toggles (home, notification) and waiting step info (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) showed no clear positive effect and hurt performance.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.
